newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian shares mixed but strong support seen.
newsitem.headline: Russian shares mixed but strong support seen.

text.p: Russian shares were mixed on Wednesday but traders said there was still high demand for many leading and secondary stocks.
"What we're looking at is a classic upmarket," said one Western trader. "It goes up for a while and then when prices are marked down there's no stock on offer."
The Russian Trading System 24-share index eased to 306.79 from Tuesday's record close of 312.60.
But utility UES and telecom Rostelekom, considered the market leaders, both closed up slightly on Tuesday's close and above recent resistance levels.
UES utility closed up at $0.2045 from $0.2020 on Tuesday. Rostelekom closed at $4.09 after $4.00 and Rostelekom prefs RTKM_p.RTS rose to $3.040 from $2.930.
"Any little corrections at this point are just aberrations in an upward trend," the Western trader said. "There are large appetites for stock and there aren't many sellers."
Renaissance Capital trader Victor Pitaleff said many investors were watching from the sidelines trying to get a sense of the market.
"Volatility is in the air. On the whole people are neutral though there is some interest in some second tiers."
